intro: Spaces are private invitation-only containers — family, friends, teams, coaches improving together. Buddy still coaches you. Your Foodiary stays yours.
buddyTip: Nothing is shared automatically. Friends see that you showed up — never your calories, weight, or Foodiary.
mission: Open Spaces on beta.kcal.lol, join Beta Testers vol 1.0 or a Space you belong to, and walk Home · Wall · Challenges · Progress · People. Settings is the gear.
why: Buddy helps you. Spaces help us. Coach Desk (later) helps many. Together that is the Health Operating System.
You never browse, search, or discover Spaces. You only see Spaces you belong to. Invitation-only.
Privacy is sacred. Share participation if you want. Calories, macros, weight, and Foodiary stay private.

what.lead: Five screens. One question each. Same in every Space.
points: Home — What are WE doing today? Hero, team faces, the challenge, Buddy (one sentence), Open Foodiary, Encourage ❤️.
Wall — What happened today? Real check-ins, joins, and encouragement. Not a chat. No fake stories.
Challenges — What are we trying to achieve? Current mission, then easy 5-day upcoming (Wall, Kludos, show up, water, a walk) still coming soon. History when a stretch ends.
Progress — How are WE improving? Consistency, participation, the challenge — never a calorie scoreboard.
People — Who is doing this together? Face, name, today, latest real achievement, Encourage ❤️.
Settings (gear) — What do I want to share? Invite lives here too.

misconceptions.myth: Spaces means public social media for my calories.
misconceptions.truth: Spaces are intentional groups. You control context and membership. Calories never appear.

misconceptions.myth: If I’m in a Space, I must be perfect for others.
misconceptions.truth: Honesty over Shame still applies. Real peers prefer truth to theatre.

how.lead: Start with people you would invite in real life.
steps: Join Beta Testers vol 1.0 (the open crew) or create one Space — Public or Private
Invite only people you actually know — nobody browses in
Show up in Foodiary. Presence returns to the Space
Encourage a quiet friend from Home or People
Leave from Settings if a Space stops feeling safe
how.buddyHelps: Buddy remains your personal coach. Spaces add belonging. Together they support the Health Operating System’s social layer.

sections.title: Family Spaces
paras: People first. Encourage each other. Never compete on weight or calories at home.
Protect kids’ dignity — Spaces are not a venue for public calorie policing.

sections.title: Coach-supported Spaces
paras: Coaches support the group. They do not own your Foodiary. Share participation; keep private logs under your control.

mistakes.quote: I inflated my logs so the group would be impressed.
mistakes.why: That breaks your Progress and the group’s trust. Honesty scales better.

mistakes.quote: I joined ten Spaces and engaged with none.
mistakes.why: Belonging needs focus. One active Space beats ten badges.

mistakes.quote: Someone shamed my weekend — so I stopped logging.
mistakes.why: Wrong culture. Address norms or leave. Don’t abandon your diary.

encouragement: Health should spread. Start with people who make showing up easier — that is already Scale Health Success.
